title: Estrangement Between Banda Singh And Tat Khalsa

blocks.text: Once the split becomes known, the Mughals exploit it, and figures such as Asalam Khan approach the Singhs with flattering words, calling them true Sikhs of Nanak rather than followers of Banda’s altered path.
The page combines propaganda and intelligence, showing the enemy praising Khalsa distinctiveness in order to isolate Banda still further.
Asalam Khan is the key anchor because he represents Mughal opportunism in the face of Sikh division.
